method: Identify what historical evidence a candidate fixture may legitimately use, and what each source can and cannot establish.

sources.name: A real first-party DSH Session page
establishes: coverage (FULL/PARTIAL/UNKNOWN) derived from the source total
durability provenance when the reader proves it
doesNotEstablish: that a specific command SUCCEEDED (no observedStatus in the Capsule)
that the Work Attempt settled or was verified
sources.usedBy: FIX-A (the origin page is genuinely PARTIAL)

sources.name: Canonical Work lineage
establishes: the governed rework origin of a consumer attempt
that A0 is a canonical attempt of the project
doesNotEstablish: that the origin execution completed cleanly

sources.name: The Execution Association qualification
establishes: the invocation selection state and unresolved alternatives
doesNotEstablish: that an unqualified invocation had no execution

currentlyCapsuleVisible: event durability, inherited flag, summary truncation flag (carried, not rendered)
invocation selection state and unresolved alternatives
canonical reality (attempt state, result refs, verification, promotion, rework state)
notCapsuleVisible: raw tool results and their error status
